# WAMOCON GmbH

> WAMOCON GmbH is an independent IT test-management and software-quality-assurance company based in Eschborn near Frankfurt am Main, Germany. It provides test management, test automation, SAP and enterprise-software testing, and AI-assisted quality assurance to enterprise clients across Germany and the European Union, in German and English.

## Key facts

- Legal name: WAMOCON GmbH
- Managing Director: Dipl.-Ing. Waleri Moretz
- Headquarters: Mergenthalerallee 79-81, 65760 Eschborn, Germany
- Commercial register: Amtsgericht Frankfurt am Main, HRB 103893
- VAT identification number: DE303792072
- Team size: 11 people (10 employees plus the managing director)
- Languages served: German and English
- Service area: Germany and the European Union
- Sister company: WAMOCON Academy GmbH, an ISTQB-accredited IT training centre

## What WAMOCON does

- IT test management for enterprise software projects
- Software quality assurance and quality management
- Test automation
- SAP and enterprise-software testing
- Custom software and AI application development
- IT consulting and flexible cooperation models, from a single tester to a full project team
